title: Type editor descriptor, contract version 1
description: What the panel's forms render a type from (PRD 11.12, 14.1, GUARDRAILS 2.4): the type's name, labels, capabilities and inferred title field, its layout of tabs and a sidebar that places every top-level field once, and its field tree as a flat list in form order, each field with its type and base, labels, presence, classification, agents flag, the choices of a select, how a group repeats, its value rule in the form of the generated validation runtime, the hints its form takes and its form-only default. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Contracts\Editors\TypeEditor, compiled by cms:generate into the application's TypeEditors, and the generated codec TypeEditorCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace. The queries type.list and type.describe answer with it, filtered to the reader.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the type declares (PRD 3.1, 5, 10.1), so a form knows whether the type has stages to release and routes to give.

description.description: What the type holds, as its blueprint describes it, or null.

descriptions.description: The description of the type per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale; empty when the blueprint gives one text.

extensions.description: The extenders of the type, sorted by namespace, each with the version of its extension; the fields each adds are under ext.<namespace> among the fields.

fields.description: The field tree as a flat list in form order: the owner's top-level fields in blueprint order, each group followed by the fields below it, then each extender's fields the same way, by namespace. A nested field names its group's path as parent, and every group comes before the fields below it.

id.description: The id of the type, a UUIDv7, which never changes.

label.description: The label of the type, as its blueprint gives it.

labels.description: The label of the type per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale; empty when the blueprint gives one text.

layout.description: The form's tabs and sidebar: every top-level field of the type is placed in exactly one section, and the fields below a group are never placed, because the group's input holds them. A type whose blueprint declares no layout gets the tab content with the section fields holding its fields in blueprint order, and the fields of an extender without a layout fragment land in the tab extensions, a section per namespace.

name.description: The name of the type, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post.

title_field.description: The path of the field a form shows an entry by: the first required text field of the owner in blueprint order, else the owner's first text field, or null when the owner has no text field.

version.description: The owner's version of the type.

capabilities.description: The capabilities a type declares in its blueprint.

history.description: How much of the type's history is kept: every revision, the audit trail only, or nothing.

localization.description: How the type is localized (PRD 10.1): none, one shared variant with every field, or variants, a variant per language that holds the translatable fields and the shared variant that holds the others.

routable.description: Whether the type's entries have routes.

stages.description: Whether the type's entries have stages: none, or a draft that is released.

choice.description: One option of a select field: the value the field stores and its label.

label.description: The label of the option, as its blueprint gives it.

labels.description: The label per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

value.description: The value the field stores, a handle.

extension.description: An extender of the type and the version of its extension.

namespace.description: The extender's namespace, the owner that added the fields, such as app.

field.description: A field of the type as a form renders it: one input, and its value rule.

agents.description: Whether MCP tools and agents see the field (PRD 2.31, 12.2): a public or internal field unless its blueprint says no, a confidential field only when its blueprint says yes, never a personal or sensitive field.

base.description: The core field type whose form the value takes: the field type itself for a core field type, and the base of its shape for an addon's. A form picks its input by it.

choices.description: The options of a select, in the blueprint's order, each value once; empty for any other base.

classification.description: The classification of the field (PRD 12.2), which decides who may read it.

default.description: The form's starting value from the blueprint's default, or null: {"kind":"constant","value":...} with the value in the record's JSON form, or {"kind":"token","token":"today"} or "now" for a date or datetime the form takes from the clock. It is form only, never filled in by a command, and a group or rich text has none.

description.description: What the field holds, as its blueprint describes it, the help text of its input; or null.

descriptions.description: The description per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

encrypted.description: Whether the value is stored as ciphertext (PRD 12.2).

fallback.description: How a translatable field falls back when the reader's language has no value for it (PRD 10.3): with its whole variant, or on its own; variant for every field that is not translatable.

handle.description: The handle of the field, as the blueprint declares it.

label.description: The label of the field, as its blueprint gives it.

labels.description: The label per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

namespace.description: The extender's namespace for an extension field, which a nested field takes from its group; null for a field of the type's owner.

parent.description: The path of the group the field is nested in, which comes before it in the list, or null for a top-level field.

path.description: The address of the field: its handle for a top-level field of the owner, ext.<namespace>.<handle> for a top-level extension field, and the parent's path, a dot and the handle inside a group.

presence.description: What the generated validator requires: required at every write, required_on_release for an extension field the blueprint requires (PRD 11.12, point 1), else optional.

repeat.description: How a repeated group repeats, or null for a group that does not repeat and for any other base.

rule.description: The field's value rule in the form of the generated validation runtime, a ValueRule as the generated TypeScript module of the type's record declares it, so a form validates with the same interpreter; null for a group, whose object or list rule the form builds from the fields below it and repeat.

translatable.description: Which variant holds the field in a type with localization variants (PRD 10.1): a language's variant when true, so a form shows the field once per language, and the shared variant when false; always false in a type without localization. A nested field takes its group's.

type.description: The field type as the blueprint names it: a core field type such as text, or <namespace>:<handle> for a field type an addon contributes (PRD 13.1).

targets.description: The types a relation's targets may have, each <owner>:<handle>, in the blueprint's order, so a picker searches entries of those types (PRD 5.11); empty for any other base.

ui.description: The hints the form takes for the input.

when.description: The condition the field is shown on (gap G3), or null for a field that is always shown: a ConditionRule of the generated validation runtime, {"op":"eq","field":{"up":0,"key":"kind"},"value":"external"} and the like, whose field is the key of a sibling in the field's object, up objects above it, an item of a repeated group being one object. While it does not hold, the field is hidden and never required.

when_hidden.description: What happens to the value of a conditional field while it is hidden: clear, the form clears it and the validators refuse one, or keep, it keeps its value; null for a field without a condition.

layout.description: The tabs of a form and the sections of its sidebar.

sidebar.description: The sections of the sidebar in form order, each handle once; empty for a form without one.

tabs.description: The tabs in form order, each handle once.

placement.description: The place of one top-level field in a section: its path among the fields and the width it takes in the row.

path.description: The path of the field, as the fields have it: a handle, or ext.<namespace>.<handle> for an extension field.

width.description: The width preset: the whole row, or a half, a third or two thirds of it.

repeat.description: How a repeated group repeats: the fewest and the most items the form lets an editor add, each null when the blueprint leaves it out.

max_items.description: The most items, or null for the blueprint's default.

min_items.description: The fewest items, or null for none.

section.description: A section: a run of placed fields, with an optional label and instructions, which a form may let the editor collapse.

collapsible.description: Whether a form lets the editor collapse the section.

fields.description: The placements of the section in form order, each path once.

handle.description: The handle of the section, as the blueprint declares it, once in its tab or in the sidebar.

instructions.description: The instructions shown with the section, or null.

instructions_by_locale.description: The instructions per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

label.description: The label of the section, or null for a section without a heading.

labels.description: The label per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

select_display.description: How a form shows the choices of a select: radio buttons, a row of buttons or a dropdown.

tab.description: A tab: a labelled page of sections.

handle.description: The handle of the tab, as the blueprint declares it.

labels.description: The label per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

sections.description: The sections of the tab in form order, each handle once.

text.description: A text in one language: the locale in its canonical case, as the kernel writes a locale, and the text.

locale.description: The locale, such as da or en-GB.

ui.description: The hints a form takes for the input, from the field's ui in its blueprint. Every member is presentation only: a read-only or hidden field is still written by the commands and validated as its rule says.

display.description: How a select shows its choices, or null to leave it to the form; null for every other base.

hidden.description: Whether the form hides the input.

input_hint.description: The hint shown in the empty input, or null.

input_hint_by_locale.description: The input hint per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

instructions.description: The instructions shown with the input, or null.

instructions_by_locale.description: The instructions per locale the blueprint names, sorted by locale.

read_only.description: Whether the form shows the value without an input to change it.

summary.description: The summary template of a repeated group, which names the group's nested fields in braces, such as {title} ({year}), so a collapsed item shows its values; null for every other field.

when_hidden.description: What happens to the value of a conditional field while it is hidden (gap G3): clear or keep.
